caption:
The AI built an order history page. Orders placed between midnight and 5:30 AM show up under yesterday.

Look at the card. toISOString() always returns the time in UTC. IST is 5 hours 30 minutes ahead, so at 00:30 IST on 5 December, UTC is still 7:00 PM on 4 December. slice(0, 10) cuts out that UTC date.

Fix: format the date in the user's time zone. toLocaleDateString with the en-CA locale gives YYYY-MM-DD, and the timeZone option picks the zone.

Your tests pass all day and fail only at night, which is why this one ships.

Source: MDN, Date.prototype.toISOString() and Intl.DateTimeFormat (timeZone).
